_doc: 版本標識檔。guardian＝Workflow Guardian（hooks + MCP server）版本，Dashboard 標題與 MCP serverInfo 顯示；atom_memory＝原子記憶系統版本；release_date＝此版本正式發布日；release_theme＝此版本主題一句話。程式讀者：tools/workflow-guardian-mcp/lib/paths.js（只取 guardian / atom_memory）與 tools/install.py --verify（確認本檔可讀）；文件讀者 TECH.md。
release_theme: atom_promote replies with success after promoting instead of a false error; usage-watch checks the Claude Code login the evening before the weekly reset (20:00 the day before, through the usage API), opens the web fallback's Chrome for signing in when it is set up, and raises a toast and a session-start hint when the check fails
